description: This file defines security dependencies for API key authentication in a FastAPI project, including classes for API key retrieval via query parameters, headers, and cookies, along with methods for handling authentication errors.

classes.name: APIKeyBase
classes.description: Base class for API key authentication security schemes, handling common logic such as constructing the APIKey model and generating not-authenticated errors.

classes.name: APIKeyQuery
classes.description: Derived class implementing API key authentication via URL query parameters.

classes.name: APIKeyHeader
classes.description: Derived class implementing API key authentication via request headers.

classes.name: APIKeyCookie
classes.description: Derived class implementing API key authentication via cookies.

methods.name: HTTPException make_not_authenticated_error(self)
methods.description: Creates an HTTP 401 Unauthorized exception with WWW-Authenticate header.

methods.name: Optional[str] check_api_key(self, api_key: Optional[str])
methods.description: Validates the provided API key, raising error if necessary based on auto_error setting.

methods.name: Optional[str] __call__(self, request: Request)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the API key from the specific location (query, header, cookie) and checks it.
